registered_before: submitting any of the calibration or sealed runs below; only the exploratory pilot (seed 101) exists
question: Does the frozen vision-caution-v2 head, trained only on the simulated runtime-scene proxy, anticipate camera-visible hazards on real robots filmed by a real camera, better than the same pipeline without the camera, while holding the false-alarm budget?

honest_scope.what_is_real: real GRITSbot robots on the Georgia Tech Robotarium executing FerrumOS runtime PhysicalAction sequences, filmed by the testbed's real overhead 1080p camera (wide-angle lens, projector light, robot LEDs and shadows); poses from the testbed's tracking system
honest_scope.what_is_not: not FerrumOS's own deployment camera or robot (none exists); the scene is the runtime world scaled 0.7, with a projected geofence and obstacle marker; contact never occurs (the testbed forbids it), so the hazards are obstacle proximity and geofence exit only
honest_scope.authority: advisory diagnostic only; no permit, block, approval, adapter or actuation authority

pilot_disclosure: Seed 101 (2026-10-22) was run before this protocol with an earlier script (white fence, no obstacle marker) and inspected: real execution fidelity, video sync and camera fitting were developed on it, and the v2 head was scored on it exploratorily (AUC-PR 0.717 vs base rate 0.455, 88 decisions). It is excluded from every set below.

runs.script: scripts/robotarium/ferrum_experiment.py at the commit that registers this protocol (black projected fence, dark disc under the parked obstacle), SEED set per run, 8 episodes x 12 steps, scale 0.7
runs.simulator_check: all ten seeds pass the official simulator's testbed checks before submission (target/robotarium/check_seeds_study.log: zero too-close, out-of-bounds and actuator counts, 409-434 s); that check also prints each seed's SIMULATED hazard prevalence (0.000-0.341). No real data and no model score existed when this protocol was registered
runs.submission: uploaded through the Robotarium web interface with the account owner's approval; files and video downloaded into target/robotarium/runs/seed<N>/ (gitignored, never redistributed)
runs.failure_rule: a run the testbed rejects or that returns no data is resubmitted once with the same seed (no outcome was observed); a run that fails the quality gate is excluded and reported, never replaced by a new seed after the open

processing.frames: scripts/robotarium/video_frames.py: video synced to the log per window of 900 iterations, camera = plane homography + one radial term + pose-to-body offset fitted on hold frames, frame at the middle of each step's hold rectified to runtime |x|,|y| <= 1.5, grey 64x64
processing.labels: scripts/robotarium/label_robotarium_log.py: body centres (pose + 0.025 m along the heading, the testbed's collision offset), runtime units (divide by 0.7); per-step hazard = moving and clearance_next < 0.16, or margin_next < 0; caution target = any hazard in the next 3 steps; decisions t = 1..11 per episode (vision_runtime_proxy_final.decisions)

quality_gate.applies_to: every calibration and sealed run, from camera.json, before any score

processing.sealed_preprocessing: video_frames.py runs on the sealed runs before the open (it writes labels into frames.npz but prints no label statistic); nothing about sealed labels or scores is inspected before the ledger entry

models.vision: frozen docs/research/artifacts/vision-caution-v2/selected_caution_head.npz (sha256 77e3ea1ed04421818e1efd6aa4b216b92b75b224c1f13e18e307345fc040042f) over frozen facebook/dinov2-small; no training on real data
models.action_only: logistic regression (C=1.0, balanced) on the 10-dim runtime action, refitted deterministically on the proxy training split (seed 200, 800 episodes) exactly as in the proxy study
models.state_reference: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=0) on true decision-time geometry + action, refitted on the same proxy split; descriptive only

arms.vision_real_cal (PRIMARY): vision logits, threshold = 0.95 quantile of the calibration runs' hazard-free decisions (half of the 0.10 budget)
arms.vision_sim_thr: vision logits, the artifact's frozen simulation threshold fpr_0.05 (pure sim-to-real transfer of the threshold)
arms.action_only: same calibration procedure as the primary arm

order: quality gate on calibration runs; thresholds computed from them only
ledger entry robotarium-sealed-v1 in target/vision-wm/final_access.jsonl; the harness refuses if it exists
quality gate on sealed runs, then every arm scored once

gates.G1_camera_beats_action_only: on the sealed decisions, vision_real_cal has higher AUC-PR and higher recall than action_only, and the episode-cluster bootstrap CI95 lower bound of the recall difference is > 0
gates.G2_budget_holds: vision_real_cal realized false-alarm rate on sealed hazard-free decisions <= 0.10
descriptive: AUC-PR and ROC of every arm
recall by hazard type and by action kind

statistics: episode-cluster bootstrap (episodes are clusters across all sealed runs), 10000 replicates, seed 0
harness: scripts/robotarium/evaluate_real.py (--dry-run, --smoke on the pilot with a temp ledger, then the single final); CPU only

consequences.if_primary_passes: first sealed real-camera evidence for the advisory; the integration protocol may add 'advisory logging on the Robotarium overhead camera' to its scope. Still not FerrumOS's own camera, still off by default, still no authority.
consequences.if_primary_fails: reported as is and retained; the advisory's scope is unchanged
